acceptance_goal: measured pass-rate lift on the dogfood set, no APU latency blow-up
aqos_mapping: aq-qa / edit-verify / behavioral-verify already score local-agent steps
claim: Step-wise process rewards + execution verification lift agent reliability; >8x compute-efficiency (AgentPRM).
proposed_slice: use aq-qa/behavioral-verify as a PRM signal so the local loop prefers a verified branch pre-commit

acceptance_goal: a compiled local-agent prompt beating the FE-2a functional baseline + tier0
aqos_mapping: aq-qa execution verifier + local Qwen judge + shared/llm_config.py prompt SSOT
claim: GEPA: gradient-free reflective prompt optimizer, +20% vs GRPO with 35x fewer rollouts; offline compile step.
proposed_slice: FE-2a functional eval metric first (baseline was a ceilinged self-probe), then FE-2b GEPA build-time compile gated by aq-qa
source: dspy.ai GEPA (ICLR 2026); gepa-ai/gepa; Microsoft MAI Qwen3-30B judge

acceptance_goal: interop gap doc + no governance regression
aqos_mapping: we run MCP (coordinator/lean-ctx) + home-grown signed-A2A (F3) + capability leases
claim: MCP=tools layer, A2A=inter-agent layer, both de-facto standards; protocols cannot express key governance.
proposed_slice: gap-check signed-A2A vs A2A v1.0 envelope; keep our capability-lease governance (we're ahead)
source: MCP spec 2025-11-25 (97M SDK dl/mo); A2A v1.0 Apr 2026 (Linux Foundation); arXiv:2606.31498

aqos_mapping: our model IS Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on an APU; tok/s measured
claim: tens-of-% to ~2x at best; NEGATIVE on some configs; NO mode faster than baseline on our Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE.
proposed_slice: do NOT schedule for the current MoE model; re-test only on a dense-model switch
source: ggml-org/llama.cpp #10466 + docs/speculative.md; community bench on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

acceptance_goal: n/a until a native 1-bit model competitive at our size exists
aqos_mapping: we run Qwen3.6-35B Q5_K_S; ceiling is RAM/VRAM not bit-width
claim: Native-trained only (no post-hoc ternary quant); largest open native 1-bit models far below 30B; 4-bit still wins for capability.
proposed_slice: monitor native 1-bit scaling; keep Q4/Q5/IQ path (matches owner decision, no lighter model)

acceptance_goal: deny-closed egress proof + no tool regression; attach to Foundation-C activation evidence
aqos_mapping: we run bwrap cells + AppArmor + capability leases + C6 epoch-fence
claim: Runtime LSM/eBPF egress + cgroup limits pin untrusted tools (e.g. MCP server to loopback-only).
proposed_slice: add a Landlock/eBPF egress pin for untrusted MCP servers (loopback-only)
source: Landlock LSM + eBPF/cilium (mature 2026); arXiv:2606.31498 governance gaps

acceptance_goal: measured longer context at equal quality on our hardware, else drop
aqos_mapping: our KV floor is a measured 1GB reserve in ai-fit; APU RAM is the binding constraint; context-engineering concept
claim: Semantic-retrieval KV-cache compression keeps ~97% LongBench perf at 3% cache; up to 17x long-context speedup (C2KV). GQA-based.
proposed_slice: benchmark CompressKV-style eviction on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B for longer usable context on the APU without quality loss

acceptance_goal: agent runs produce OTel-conformant spans consumable by standard tooling; no telemetry regression
aqos_mapping: our observability = agent-run-events.jsonl + health-spider + dashboard; aq-qa/tier0 already cover the eval/safety layer OTel omits (we're ahead there)
claim: OTel GenAI conventions standardize agent traces (model, tokens, tool calls, latency, reasoning) into one hierarchical trace + MCP tool calling; but NOT output eval/safety scoring.
proposed_slice: emit agent-run-events as OTel GenAI spans to align telemetry with the standard; keep aq-qa as the eval layer OTel does not provide
source: opentelemetry.io/blog/2026 GenAI observability; GenAI SIG; Datadog/MLflow OTel GenAI
